name: Metro UI
summary: Flat colour tiles, large light typography, a strict grid and content before chrome. It came from Windows Phone 7 in 2010 and drew on Swiss signage and airport wayfinding.

philosophy.core_thesis: Content is the interface: remove chrome, use type and motion for hierarchy, and let flat colour tiles carry the brand.
design_principles: Build the home screen from tiles on a 12px grid; use tiles of 1, 2 and 4 units (for example 80px, 168px and 344px).
Use one solid accent colour per tile from a set of 8 to 12 saturated colours; tile gutters are 8px.
Set a huge page title in light weight (300) at 40px to 72px, partly cut off by the right edge to signal a pan.
Use no gradient, no shadow and no gloss; a tile is a flat rectangle with a 0px radius.
Draw icons as simple white line glyphs inside a 2px circle or on a tile; one stroke width of 2px.
Align all text flush left to a 12px margin; labels are 14px, lower case.
Move the content on pan and tile flips: entrance by slide of 40px with a stagger of 40ms per item.
anti_patterns: Chrome that competes with content, such as heavy toolbars

layout.grid_mechanics: A tile grid of 12px units with 8px gutters; the content column starts at a 12px margin; a panorama runs past the right edge.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 20% to 30% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 12, 24 and 48px.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush left; titles and tiles align to the 12px grid; the right edge is cut off by design.
layout.container_geometry: Flat rectangles and squares with a 0px radius; no borders; the colour is the boundary.

font_pairings.note: A Segoe-like humanist that has a light 300 weight for display.

hierarchy_rules: Use three weights: light (300) for display, regular (400) for body, semibold (600) for labels.
Set titles in light weight, in lower case.
Cut the page title by the right edge to hint at more content.

color.palette_structure: Black or white ground with one saturated colour per tile.
color.contrast_rules: White on black holds 21:1; white on each tile colour holds at least 4.5:1.
color.surface_treatment: Flat, opaque colour; no gradient or texture.

materiality.surface_simulation: Digital paper and signage: flat colour with no simulated material.
materiality.border_rules: No borders; a 2px outline appears only for focus.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur. No elevation. Shadow is none.

ornamentation_details.iconography: White line glyphs on a 24px field with a 2px stroke, butt caps and mitre joins, inside a 2px circle for app-bar buttons.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Photographs and typography only; no illustration.

motion.transition_physics: Fluent, directional motion: pages turn and slide in from the side; tiles flip in a 3D turn of 180° over 300ms and items stagger by 40ms.
motion.hover_and_active: Press tilts a tile by 4° toward the touch point and dims it by 10%; no hover on touch.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels clarity, speed and a modern, typographic order.

use_cases: internal tools with a clear tone
avoid_when: The brand must feel warm or luxurious.
The product needs rich imagery in each card.
The UI has deep nested navigation.

modifiers.how: Add elevation levels and a 2px radius; keep the tile colours.
Reduce to black and white and one red accent on a 12-column grid.
Add a 1px border and a 12px radius to the tiles.

pack.why: A plain 2px line glyph with sharp joins that sits well inside a thin circle.

ground.why: Metro is a wall of flat live tiles in solid colour on a black field.
